note: Both sets bind the Flexinol wire forces (2500 g martensite, 2900 g austenite), the 400 g total actuation force, and the 30/12 percent heating/cooling load shares correctly with supporting quotes. Set A additionally extracts the 64 total louvers per operable screen bay and states the 32 louvers actuated per wire as a clean numeric claim, whereas Set B folds that into a vaguer 'actuation capacity: 32 of the 64 louvers' and omits the 64-louver total. Set A's claims are therefore slightly more complete and precise without introducing errors.
